title: Flagstick Fuel
description: Electrify your short game and lock in your focus with Flagstick Fuel, a premium center-shafted mallet putter cover that brings iconic, high-energy swagger straight to the green. Featuring a bold lightning bolt design and custom "flavor-block" embroidery for your scorecard status, this cover is built to quench your thirst for lower scores. Crafted with high-quality materials and a plush velvet interior, Flagstick Fuel keeps your putter safely protected from scratches, dings, and golf cart clutter. It’s vibrant, confident, and engineered to keep your momentum flowing all round long.

title: The Corduroy
description: Meet The Corduroy — your putter's new go-to fit. This cover's got the texture of your favorite throwback jacket and the swagger to match, with a sage suede stripe running clean down the middle and our signature leather patch holding it all together. Protects your flatstick, upgrades your bag - no notes. Crafted with high-quality materials and a plush velvet interior, The Corduroy keeps your putter safely protected from scratches, dings, and golf cart clutter. Keep your putter safe and your bag looking like it means business all round long.

title: Sunday Stripes
description: Sunday Stripes brings a touch of coastal class and vintage charm to your golf bag. Featuring a timeless light blue and white pinstripe pattern, this cover is anchored by a detailed embroidery of a classic mariner taking a well-earned break. It’s more than just protection—it’s a nod to the "slow play" of the seaside, designed for the golfer who appreciates a sharp look and a steady hand.

title: The Birdie Machine
description: Add some "groovy" vibes to your golf bag with this premium mallet putter cover. Inspired by the most famous van in cartoon history, this cover replaces mystery-solving with birdie-hunting. Features a high-quality embroidery of the "Birdie Machine" van, complete with psychedelic flower power decals and a classic teal-and-lime color scheme.

title: The Breakfast Roller

It’s fun, it’s confident, and it’s built to perform.
